scope: isolated extracted-function and AST probes; no SDK imports, model calls or full runtime tests

observations.observation: Swarm app mock embeddings are nonzero 128-dimensional pseudorandom vectors.
Team core lite memory retains keyword hit at 0.2 when vector unavailable (keyword floor 0.1).
Swarm app path with vector failure weights keyword 0.2 by 0.3 => 0.06, then filters it at minScore 0.3.
HybridRetriever.retrieve ignores supplied filters and calls store with filters=None.
Skill declarations compose by allow union and deny union; empty effective allow remains unfiltered.
COMPLETED and CANCELLED share downstream dependency resolution in termination helper.
Harness preset uses forked compressor; min_target_context_ratio guards minimum compressible span, not output ratio.
